item.title: [anomalyco/opentui] Release v0.9.0 (v0.9.0)
item.description:
In 0.9.0, Markdown runs on OpenTUI's native engine, the same engine the Rust widget uses. In 0.8.3, `MarkdownRenderable` parsed with `marked` in JavaScript and lexed the open end of the document again on every chunk. In a growing list, the open end is the whole list, so streaming one list took 21,430 million instructions. `MarkdownRenderable` also sent all prose to the Tree-sitter worker for styling. The native engine reads each chunk once and writes paragraphs and headings into their text nodes itself. Streaming the same list now takes 5.9 million instructions. Over one streamed answer, JavaScript's styled-text writes for prose went from 1,595 to 0, and the prose characters sent to the highlighter went from 56,223 to 0.
Because the engine follows CommonMark 0.31.2 and GFM, some documents look different. While streaming, a line that can still change kind, such as a possible table row or a heading underline, waits for its end before it shows. A table appears when its delimiter row arri

item.title: [pnpm/pnpm] pnpm 12.21 (v12.21.0)
item.description:
pnpm 12.21.0 lets `pnpm store add` prepare tarball and git dependencies for offline installs. It also makes repeated installs keep their peer dependency choices and fixes several `lockfile.format: v13`, `nodeLinker: hoisted`, and `pnpm deploy` failures. If a pnpr server refuses a setting, pnpm now resolves locally.
### Minor Changes
- `pnpm store add` run in a project now prepares downloaded tarballs for every lockfile entry that pins them. Besides registry packages, `pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile` can then install dependencies on a tarball URL and dependencies on a git host such as GitHub whose lockfile entry records an `integrity`.
### Patch Changes
#### Installs that failed
- pnpm now reads a lockfile with a mapping key longer than 1,024 characters written as `'key':`, without the `? ` marker. Before, `pnpm install` and other commands failed on such a lockfile with `ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_LOCKFILE`.
- With `lockfile.format: v13`, `pnpm install` no longer fails

item.title: [cli/cli] GitHub CLI 2.104.0 (v2.104.0)
item.description:
## Protect private forks when deleting repositories
`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.
Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:
```shell gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks ```
## What's Changed
### ✨ Features
* Require confirmation before `gh repo delete` deletes private forks by @BagToad in #14858
### 🐛 Fixes
* fix(auth status): surface underlying rate-limit, server, and network errors in terminal output by @babakks and @Copilot in #15009 * fix(auth): skip token refresh when `gh`'s state directory is not writable by @babakks in #14845
### 📚 Docs & Chores
* Use REST to apply issue triage labels by @BagToad in #15041 * Prevent repeated Dependabot triage assessments by @BagToad in #15002 * Apply issue triage labels directly by @BagToad in #1500

item.title: [nanaism/yomiyasu] v3.1.0
item.description:
yomiyasu v3.1.0 を公開しました。 スキルのフォルダから Codex 用のプラグインの設定を外したバージョンです。 Codex にスキルのフォルダを写して入れている方は、スキルの名前が `yomiyasu:yomiyasu` から `yomiyasu` に変わります。更新したあとに書き換える所は、下の「Codex で使っている方へ」にあります。 名前が変わるので、パッチではなくマイナーバージョンにしています。 推敲の手順（SKILL.md と references）は、SKILL.md のバージョンの行を除いて v3.0.1 から変えていません。 lint、diff、check、フックの出力も、JSON の `tool_version` と `--version` が示すバージョンを除いて v3.0.1 と同じです。
## 背景と課題
パッケージマネージャーの apm で yomiyasu をプロジェクトに入れようとすると失敗する、という報告をいただきました（Hol1kgmg さんの issue #61）。
apm は、依存先を `nanaism/yomiyasu/skills/yomiyasu` のようにフォルダまで書くと、そのフォルダの中身だけを見て種類を決めます。 apm 0.35.0 からは、フォルダに `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` があると、SKILL.md より先にこれを見て「Codex のプラグイン」と決めるようになりました。 apm は Codex のプラグインをユーザー単位でしか入れない決まりにしているので、プロジェクト単位の `apm install` が止まります。
このファイルは v2.0.2 で置いたもので、Codex でのスキルの名前を `yomiyasu:yomiyasu` にするための、名前だけの設定です。 yomiyasu はこれまで、スキルの名前を「バージョンを上げても変えないもの」として扱ってきました。 名前を保つかぎり、スキルのフォルダは「スキルでもプラグインでもあるもの」のまま残ります。
## v3.1.0 で変わったこと
スキルのフォルダから `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` を外しました。 スキルのフォルダは、プラグインの設定を持たない、ふつうのス

item.title: [microsoft/playwright] v1.65.0
item.description:
## 🥟 Run tests with Bun
The test runner now runs under Bun. Bun transpiles your TypeScript test files itself, so Playwright does not use Babel or its compilation cache. Pass the `--bun` flag, because without it `bunx playwright test` runs on Node.js:
```bash bunx --bun playwright test ```
Our CI runs the test runner tests under Bun 1.4.3 on Linux. Some features work differently under Bun:
- There is no watch mode. UI mode does not run tests again when files change, and `--only-changed` does not follow imports. - Bun loads modules itself, so `--tsconfig` and the JSX options in `tsconfig.json` have no effect, and custom ESM loaders are not supported. - Stack traces do not include async frames, and API names do not include the class name: `click` instead of `locator.click`. This changes some step locations, step titles and error messages. - Console output of a test does not get into the trace and UI mode.

item.description:
## What's Changed
- Nanocoder's ACP agent now honours the `mcpServers` an editor sends on `session/new`, `session/load` and `session/resume`. Stdio and HTTP servers are connected for that session only, so their tools exist in that session (and in subagents it starts) and in no other, and your own MCP configuration is never read or changed. Loading or resuming a session replaces its previous servers, and closing it, or deleting it, disconnects them. A server that fails to connect, or uses SSE, is logged and skipped and the request still succeeds. `initialize` now reports `mcpCapabilities` (`http`). A tool whose name an existing tool already has is skipped, and these tools follow the usual approval rules. Sessions with no servers behave as before. - ACP extension requests now use the `_` prefix ACP reserves for custom methods: `_nanocoder/renameSession`, `_nanocoder/timeline/list`, `_nanocoder/timeline/revert` and `_nanocoder/retryTurn`.
